title: Retained actual native book record and Arrow lowering
question: Can the retained actual whole-book native graph be lowered into the private model-bound record/IPC route, and what global working set remains?
method: Read retained task2 native JSON in a read-only PostgreSQL transaction, hydrate DoclingDocument, release original JSON text, lower all native fields into model-bound stage batches, mmap every IPC replay and verify schema, checksum and batch byte maximum.
conclusion: Actual retained native graph hydration, lossless record walking and schema/checksum/batch-limit verification passed for all1589pages. Native global graph stays materialized by the selected execution boundary. No fresh inference, page/raster stream, DB adoption, reading-order construction or integrated companion graph was exercised; strict end-to-end memory bound and comparative speed remain unestablished.
